query.description: Search query (keywords, artist name, track name, etc.)

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter results

limit.description: Maximum number of results per type (default 20, max 50)

include.description: Additional data to include beyond basic artist info

albumTypes.description: Comma-separated album types to filter: album, single, appears_on, compilation

action.description: "get" to fetch a specific album, "newReleases" to browse new releases

trackIds.description: One or more Spotify track IDs

includeAudioFeatures.description: Whether to include audio features (danceability, energy, tempo, etc.)

playlistId.description: Spotify playlist ID (required for get, update, addItems, removeItems, reorder)

name.description: Playlist name (required for create, optional for update)

uris.description: Spotify URIs to add or remove (e.g., spotify:track:xxx)

position.description: Position to insert items for addItems action

contextUri.description: Spotify URI of the context to play (album, artist, playlist)

uris.description: List of Spotify track URIs to play

offsetPosition.description: Zero-based position in context to start playing

offsetUri.description: Spotify URI within context to start playing from

positionMs.description: Position in milliseconds to seek to

uri.description: Spotify URI to add to queue

play.description: Whether to start playing immediately after transfer

trackIds.description: Spotify track IDs (for save, remove, or check operations)

albumIds.description: Spotify album IDs (for save, remove, or check operations)

userId.description: Spotify user ID to look up. Omit to get the current authenticated user's profile.

type.description: Whether to get top artists or tracks

timeRange.description: Time range: short_term (4 weeks), medium_term (6 months), long_term (several years). Defaults to medium_term.

limit.description: Max number of items to return (default 20, max 50)

ids.description: Spotify IDs of artists or users

isPublic.description: Whether to publicly show that the user follows the playlist

after.description: Cursor for pagination of followed artists

limit.description: Max number of items to return (default 20, max 50)

after.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds — return items played after this timestamp

before.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds — return items played before this timestamp
